summary.notes: codedamn /problem-list/nodejs pages 1-20 were JS-rendered and returned no content via WebFetch; LeetCode /problemset/javascript/ returned 403. Fell back to WebSearch (10+ queries hitting different concept buckets) to surface real /problem/<slug> URLs on codedamn and JS-tagged problems on LeetCode (study-plan 30-days-of-javascript). Buckets with few real problems (hoisting, prototype, event-loop) supplemented with canonical interview items.
